faqs.question: Do you teach both Mac and Windows computers?
faqs.answer: Yes! I provide coaching on both Mac (macOS) and Windows (10/11) computers. The fundamentals are similar, and I adapt to whatever device you have at home.

faqs.question: Do you offer virtual/remote sessions?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. I offer both in-home sessions (Ottawa, Barrhaven, Nepean, Kanata) and virtual sessions via Zoom or FaceTime. Virtual sessions work well for iPad/iPhone coaching and screen-sharing on computers.

faqs.question: What if I've never used a computer before?
faqs.answer: That's exactly who I help! Many of my students start with zero experience. We go at your pace, repeat topics as needed, and I provide written notes after every session so you can practice between lessons.

faqs.question: How long are sessions and how many do I need?
faqs.answer: Sessions are typically 1–2 hours. Most students book weekly or bi-weekly. The number of sessions depends on your goals — some people need 3–4 sessions for a specific skill (like video calling), while others prefer ongoing learning. No contracts or minimum commitments.

faqs.question: Do you help with online banking and security?
faqs.answer: Yes, online banking safety is one of my most requested topics. I teach you how to log in securely, set up two-factor authentication, recognize phishing scams, pay bills, and shop online safely — all using your actual bank's website or app.

faqs.question: What areas do you serve for in-home sessions?
faqs.answer: I serve Ottawa, Barrhaven, Nepean, and Kanata. If you're just outside these areas, let's chat — I may still be able to accommodate you, or we can do virtual sessions instead.

faqs.question: Is there a free consultation?
faqs.answer: Yes! I offer a free 15-minute phone or video consultation. We'll discuss your goals, comfort level, and device setup. No pressure, no commitment — just a chance to see if we're a good fit.
